rules.subject: User
rules.description: Access to application endpoints must be controlled and require authentication

rules.subject: System
rules.description: Event logging should capture actions affecting information security

rules.subject: System
rules.description: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak hash algorithms such as MD5

rules.subject: System
rules.description: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak ciphers and insecure modes

rules.subject: System
rules.description: Security-sensitive code should avoid predictable randomness sources (e.g., java.util.Random)

rules.subject: Developer
rules.description: Application code should prevent SQL injection by avoiding dynamic SQL concatenation with untrusted input

rules.subject: Developer
rules.description: Application code should prevent path traversal by avoiding direct file path construction from untrusted input

rules.subject: Developer
rules.description: Application code should prevent command injection by avoiding shell or process command construction from untrusted input

rules.subject: Developer
rules.description: Application code should prevent LDAP injection by avoiding concatenated LDAP filter construction with untrusted input

rules.subject: Developer
rules.description: Application code should prevent XPath injection by avoiding concatenated XPath expression construction with untrusted input
